Build Feature 1 (Team Activity Feed) and Feature 4 (Team Dashboard) for Rankora at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`.

Read CLAUDE.md first. Then read these files before writing any code:
- `src/App.tsx`
- `src/components/JobSidebar.tsx`
- `src/pages/Team.tsx`
- `src/hooks/useTeam.tsx`
- `src/hooks/useTasks.tsx`
- `src/pages/Tasks.tsx` (for SidebarLayout/FadeIn/StaggerList patterns)
- `src/components/NotificationBell.tsx` (for notification patterns)
- `supabase/migrations/20260407200000_add_tasks_and_team_notifications.sql` (for trigger patterns)

## Feature 1: Team Activity Feed

### 1A. DB Migration — `supabase/migrations/20260408100000_add_activity_log.sql`

Create `activity_log` table:
```sql
CREATE TABLE public.activity_log (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  team_id     uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  actor_id    uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  action      text NOT NULL,
  entity_type text,
  entity_id   uuid,
  metadata    jsonb DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

- Index on `(team_id, created_at DESC)` and `(team_id, action)`
- RLS: SELECT for authenticated users who are team members via `public.is_team_member(auth.uid(), team_id)`. INSERT with `WITH CHECK (true)` so SECURITY DEFINER triggers can insert.
- Add to `supabase_realtime` publication
- Create SECURITY DEFINER trigger functions (following pattern from existing `notify_task_assigned()` and `notify_note_added()` in migration 20260407200000):

  1. **On team_members INSERT** → log `member_joined`, metadata: `{email: NEW user email if available}`
  2. **On tasks INSERT** → log `task_created`, metadata: `{title: NEW.title, job_id: NEW.job_id}`
  3. **On tasks UPDATE when status changes to 'done'** → log `task_completed`, metadata: `{title: NEW.title}`
  4. **On candidate_notes INSERT** → log `note_added`, metadata: `{job_id: NEW.job_id, resume_id: NEW.resume_id}`
  5. **On applications INSERT** → log `application_received`, metadata: `{name: NEW.name, job_id: NEW.job_id}`

  Each trigger: look up team_id from the relevant join (tasks already have team_id, candidate_notes join via jobs.team_id, applications join via jobs.team_id, team_members already have team_id). Use `EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL` to prevent blocking.

### 1B. Hook — `src/hooks/useActivityFeed.tsx`

Follow the exact pattern from `src/hooks/useTasks.tsx`:
- `useQuery` with queryKey `["activity-feed", teamId, filter]`
- Query `activity_log` table via `(supabase as any).from("activity_log")` (not in generated types)
- Filter by `team_id`, optionally by `action` if filter provided
- Order by `created_at DESC`, limit 50
- Realtime subscription on `activity_log` filtered by `team_id=eq.${teamId}`, invalidate query on change
- Support cursor-based pagination: accept `before` timestamp param, return `{ activities, isLoading, hasMore, loadMore }`

Interface:
```typescript
export interface ActivityItem {
  id: string;
  team_id: string;
  actor_id: string | null;
  action: string;
  entity_type: string | null;
  entity_id: string | null;
  metadata: Record<string, any>;
  created_at: string;
}
```

### 1C. Shared Component — `src/components/ActivityItem.tsx`

Renders a single activity feed item. Used by both Activity page and Team dashboard.

Props:
```typescript
interface ActivityItemProps {
  activity: ActivityItem;
  compact?: boolean; // true = dashboard mode (less padding, shorter text)
}
```

Rendering:
- Left: Avatar circle with actor initials (first 2 chars of actor_id if no email, or "SY" for system). Use the same `bg-primary/10 text-primary` circle pattern from CandidateNotesPanel.
- Middle: Action text describing what happened. Map action types to human-readable text:
  - `member_joined` → "A new member joined the team"
  - `task_created` → "created task **{title}**"
  - `task_completed` → "completed task **{title}**"
  - `note_added` → "added a note on a candidate"
  - `application_received` → "**{name}** applied for a position"
- Right: Relative timestamp via `formatDistanceToNow`
- Action type icon on the left side of text (use same icons as NotificationBell ICON_MAP pattern)
- `compact` mode: reduce padding, hide some metadata, use text-xs

### 1D. Page — `src/pages/Activity.tsx`

Follow `src/pages/Tasks.tsx` layout pattern exactly:
- `SidebarLayout` wrapper
- `FadeIn` header: "Activity" title + subtitle "See what your team has been up to"
- Filter tabs as buttons: "All", "Tasks", "Notes", "Stages", "Applications", "Members" — each sets a filter state that maps to action types
- `StaggerList` of `ActivityItem` components (compact=false)
- "Load more" button at bottom when hasMore is true
- Empty state: Activity icon + "No activity yet" + "Activity from your team will appear here"
- Loading: skeleton (4 rows of h-12 rounded bars)

### 1E. Router + Nav

**Modify `src/App.tsx`:**
- Add eager import: `import Activity from "./pages/Activity";`
- Add route inside MaintenanceGate: `<Route path="/activity" element={<ProtectedRoute><Activity /></ProtectedRoute>} />`

**Modify `src/components/JobSidebar.tsx`:**
- Import `Activity` icon from lucide-react
- Add to `mainNav` array AFTER the Tasks entry:
```javascript
{
  icon: Activity,
  label: "Activity",
  isActive: pathname === "/activity",
  onClick: () => navigate("/activity"),
  show: isAuthenticated,
},
```

---

## Feature 4: Team Dashboard

### 4A. Hook — `src/hooks/useTeamDashboard.tsx`

```typescript
interface TeamDashboardData {
  totalJobs: number;
  activeCandidates: number;
  pendingTasks: number;
  memberCount: number;
  recentActivity: ActivityItem[];
  tasksByAssignee: { user_id: string; pending: number; completed: number }[];
}
```

- Use `useQuery` with queryKey `["team-dashboard", teamId]`
- Fetch all stats via `Promise.all`:
  1. Count jobs where team_id = teamId: `(supabase as any).from("jobs").select("id", { count: "exact", head: true }).eq("team_id", teamId)`
  2. Count resumes in those jobs (active candidates): join via jobs
  3. Count tasks where team_id = teamId AND status != 'done'
  4. Members count from team_members
  5. Last 5 activity_log items for this team
  6. Task summary by assignee: group tasks by assigned_to, count pending vs completed
- `staleTime: 60_000`

### 4B. Enhance Team Page — `src/pages/Team.tsx`

Add a dashboard section at the TOP of the `StaggerList` (before the invite card). Import `useTeamDashboard` and `ActivityItem`.

**Stats Cards Row** — grid of 4 compact Card components (2x2 on mobile, 4-col on desktop):
```
| Total Jobs (Briefcase icon) | Active Candidates (FileText icon) | Pending Tasks (CheckSquare icon) | Team Members (Users icon) |
```
Each card: icon + large number + label text. Use existing `Card`/`CardContent`. Style: `p-4`, icon in `h-8 w-8 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary`, number in `text-2xl font-bold`, label in `text-xs text-muted-foreground`.

**Recent Activity Card** — below stats:
- CardHeader: "Recent Activity" title + "View all →" link to /activity
- CardContent: list of last 5 ActivityItem components with `compact={true}`
- Empty: "No activity yet"

**Task Summary by Assignee Card** — below recent activity:
- Small table: "Member" | "Pending" | "Completed"
- Each row: user_id (truncated) | pending count | completed count
- Skip if no tasks

Only show dashboard section when team exists and is loaded.

---

## Critical constraints:
- NEVER edit `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts`
- Use `(supabase as any)` for all new tables (activity_log not in generated types)
- Import from `@/` path alias always
- Use shadcn-ui components only from `src/components/ui/`
- Sonner `toast.success()` / `toast.error()` for notifications
- Run `npm run build` at the end to verify zero TypeScript errors

1	# Instant Resume Ranker (Rankora)
2	
3	AI-powered resume screening SaaS. Users paste a job description, upload resumes, and the system scores/ranks candidates using GPT-4o.
4	
5	## Stack
6	
7	- **Frontend:** React 18.3 + TypeScript, Vite (dev port 8080), React Router 6
8	- **UI:** Tailwind CSS 3.4 + shadcn-ui, Lucide icons, Sonner toasts, Recharts
9	- **State:** React Query 5 (server state), React Hook Form + Zod (forms)
10	- **Backend:** Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Edge Functions + Storage)
11	- **AI:** OpenAI GPT-4o (resume analysis, JD parsing, scoring)
12	- **Payments:** Dodo Payments (subscriptions + one-time credit packs, hosted checkout)
13	- **Email:** Resend (transactional notifications) + inbound webhook (resume ingestion)
14	- **Vectors:** pgvector extension with HNSW indexes

99	
100	## Database Models (Supabase/PostgreSQL)
101	
102	- **profiles** — user_id, credits, plan, inbox_email, email_enabled
103	- **jobs** — user_id, job_description, title, status (pending|processing|completed|failed), scoring weights (must/nice/optional), jd_analysis_json, dynamic_weights_json, jd_embedding (vector)
104	- **resumes** — job_id, filename, file_path, candidate_name, status (pending|done|failed), parsed_json, parsed_text, embedding (vector)
105	- **results** — resume_id, job_id, overall_score, skill_score, experience_score, education_score, missing_skills[], red_flags, matched_must_haves, missing_must_haves, category_scores_json, confidence, hard_fit, strengths_json, gaps_json, explanation_json, interview_questions[]
106	- **users / user_roles** — auth + role enum (admin|user), helper: has_role(), is_job_owner()
107	- **plans** — name, price, credits, billing_type, dodo_product_id, active
108	- **credit_packs** — name, price, credits, active, is_trial, dodo_product_id, dodo_credit_entitlement_id
109	- **payments** — user_id, amount, credits_purchased, status, dodo_payment_id
110	- **feature_flags** — key (unique), enabled, label, description, value_json, category
111	- **platform_config** — singleton: max_resumes_per_job, max_file_size_mb, resume_retention_days, email_ingestion_enabled, payg_per_resume_cost
112	- **ranking_config** — system prompt, model name, temperature, weights
113	- **seo_settings / seo_pages** — meta tags, OG, structured data, analytics
114	- **email_templates** — customizable outbound emails
115	- **admin_audit_logs** — admin_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details
116	- **feedback / score_versions** — model evaluation data
117	- **email_ingest_logs** — user_id, job_id, sender, status, attachments_count
118	- **usage_logs** — user_id, job_id, credits_used
119	- **subscription_webhooks** — Dodo Payments webhook audit trail
120	
121	## Component Dependency Map
122	
123	```
124	App.tsx → AuthProvider → QueryClientProvider → BrowserRouter
125	├── Index.tsx
126	│   ├── AppHeader (useAuth, useNavigate)
127	│   ├── JobSidebar (pastJobs[], selectedJobId, onSelectJob, onDeleteJob)
128	│   ├── JobDetailView (useAuth, usePlatformConfig, useFeatureFlags)
129	│   │   ├── ScoreSummaryCards (results[])
130	│   │   ├── CandidateRow (result, resume, expanded, onToggle)
131	│   │   └── AuthDialog → AuthForm
132	│   └── AuthDialog
133	├── Auth.tsx → AppHeader, AuthForm
134	├── Settings.tsx → AppHeader, AccountInfoCard, EmailInboxCard, ChangePasswordCard, UsageHistoryCard, PaymentHistoryCard
135	├── Admin.tsx → AppHeader, AdminSidebar, [DashboardTab|UsersTab|BillingTab|...]
136	└── NotFound.tsx
137	```
138	
139	## Architecture Rules
140	
141	1. **Auth-first:** All data access uses Supabase RLS policies. Never bypass auth.
142	2. **shadcn-ui only:** Use components from `src/components/ui/`. No other UI libraries.
143	3. **Path aliases:** Always import with `@/` prefix (maps to `src/`).
144	4. **React Query:** All server state via React Query hooks. No raw `useEffect` for data fetching.
145	5. **Single Supabase client:** Import from `@/integrations/supabase/client.ts`. Never create new clients.
146	6. **Edge Functions:** Business logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno). Frontend calls via `supabase.functions.invoke()`.
147	7. **Credits system:** All ranking operations deduct credits via `deduct_credits()` DB function.
148	8. **Admin audit:** Log all admin mutations via `logAuditAction()` from `@/lib/auditLog.ts`.
149	9. **No hardcoded secrets:** All keys via environment variables (VITE_ prefix for frontend).
150	10. **Auto-generated types:** `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` is auto-generated. Do not manually edit.
151	11. **Sonner toasts:** Use `toast.success()`, `toast.error()` from sonner. No other notification system.
152	12. **Error handling:** Try-catch with toast for user-facing errors. Validation errors as arrays displayed inline.
153	13. **Real-time subscriptions:** Feature flags and SEO settings use Supabase real-time subscriptions + React Query invalidation.
154	
155	## Key Data Flows
156	
157	### Resume Ranking Pipeline
158	```
159	User enters JD + uploads files
160	→ validateFields() checks input
161	→ Create job record (status: pending)
162	→ analyzeJd() → analyze-jd edge function → stores jd_analysis_json
163	→ uploadFilesFromSnapshot() → Supabase Storage + resume records
164	→ rank-resumes edge function (GPT-4o scoring, skill matching)
165	→ rankAndPoll() polls job.status every 2s (max 60 iterations)
166	→ Fetch results from results table
167	→ Merge with resume data, sort by overall_score desc
168	→ Display ScoreSummaryCards + CandidateRow list
169	→ refreshProfile() updates credit count
170	```
171	
172	### Credit System
173	```
174	Check profiles.credits ≥ required
175	→ deduct_credits(user_id, amount) [atomic DB function]
176	→ Log to usage_logs
177	→ Proceed with AI operation
178	→ On failure: no auto-refund (credits already deducted)
179	```
180	
181	### Payment Flows
182	```
183	One-time: BuyCreditsDialog → create-dodo-checkout → redirect to Dodo hosted checkout → dodo-webhook → add credits → PaymentCallback verifies
184	Subscription: SubscriptionDialog → create-dodo-checkout (subscription product) → Dodo checkout → dodo-webhook → update plan+credits
185	Cancellation: cancel-dodo-subscription → plan active until subscription_ends_at → check-expired-subscriptions (cron) → downgrade to free
186	```
187	
188	## Known Code Patterns
189	
190	- **Polling pattern:** `rankAndPoll()` in JobDetailView uses setInterval with iteration counter
191	- **Ref tracking:** `rankingFilesRef` and `resultsRef` track state outside React lifecycle
192	- **Feature flag defaults:** `useFeatureFlag()` returns `enabled: false` before loading (race condition potential)
193	- **SEO type workaround:** `(supabase as any)` cast for seo_settings/seo_pages (not in auto-generated types)
194	- **Dodo hosted checkout:** Both BuyCreditsDialog and SubscriptionDialog use create-dodo-checkout for redirect-based payment
195	- **Admin section mapping:** `sectionComponents` object in Admin.tsx maps section names to components
196	
197	## Commands
198	
199	```bash
200	npm install          # Install dependencies
201	npm run dev          # Start dev server (localhost:8080)
202	npm run build        # Production build
203	npm run test         # Run tests (Vitest)
204	npm run test:watch   # Watch mode tests
205	npx eslint .         # Lint
206	
207	# Supabase
208	supabase functions deploy <name>
209	supabase db push
210	supabase gen types typescript --project-id zkzontawprihrzpayeam > src/integrations/supabase/types.ts
211	```
212	
213	## Safety Rules (CRITICAL)
214	
215	1. **NEVER delete or overwrite existing data/files without explicit user request**
216	2. **NEVER modify payment/billing logic without careful review** — broken payments = lost revenue
217	3. **NEVER change RLS policies without understanding the full security impact**
218	4. **NEVER modify `types.ts`** — it is auto-generated
219	5. **NEVER hardcode API keys, URLs with secrets, or credentials**
220	6. **ALWAYS run `npm run build` after changes to verify no type errors**
221	7. **ALWAYS preserve existing error handling** — do not remove try-catch blocks
222	8. **ALWAYS maintain backward compatibility** — existing API contracts must not break
223	9. **When in doubt, ask the user** — never guess about business logic
224

124	RETURNS TRIGGER

203	  AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.tasks

236	  SELECT r.candidate_name

238	  FROM   public.resumes r
239	  WHERE  r.id = NEW.resume_id;
240	
241	  -- Notify each team member except the person who changed the stage
242	  FOR _member IN
243	    SELECT tm.user_id
244	    FROM   public.team_members tm
245	    WHERE  tm.team_id = _team_id
246	      AND  tm.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.changed_by
247	  LOOP
248	    BEGIN
249	      INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, type, title, message, metadata)
250	      VALUES (

-- ============================================================
-- Depends on:

-- ============================================================


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. TABLE
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE public.activity_log (
  id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  team_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  actor_id    uuid        REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  action      text        NOT NULL,
  entity_type text,
  entity_id   uuid,
  metadata    jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX idx_activity_log_team_time   ON public.activity_log(team_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_activity_log_team_action ON public.activity_log(team_id, action);


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. RLS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.activity_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Team members can read their team's activity
CREATE POLICY "Team members can view activity"
  ON public.activity_log FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (public.is_team_member(auth.uid(), team_id));

-- Allow SECURITY DEFINER trigger functions to insert without JWT check
CREATE POLICY "Triggers can insert activity"
  ON public.activity_log FOR INSERT TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (true);

-- Also allow service_role (used by triggers running as SECURITY DEFINER)
CREATE POLICY "Service role can insert activity"
  ON public.activity_log FOR INSERT TO service_role
  WITH CHECK (true);


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. REALTIME
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.activity_log;


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 4. TRIGGER FUNCTIONS
-- Each is SECURITY DEFINER so it can INSERT into activity_log
-- regardless of the calling user's RLS policies.
-- All wrapped in EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS to never block the main op.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_member_joined()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.activity_log (team_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata)
    VALUES (
      NEW.team_id,
      NEW.user_id,
      'member_joined',
      'team_member',
      NEW.id,
      '{}'::jsonb
    );
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

  AFTER INSERT ON public.team_members
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_member_joined();

SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.activity_log (team_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata)
    VALUES (

      'task_created',

RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public

BEGIN

CREATE TRIGGER trg_log_task_completed
  AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.tasks

  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_task_completed();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_note_added()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _team_id uuid;
BEGIN

  SELECT j.team_id INTO _team_id
  FROM public.jobs j
  WHERE j.id = NEW.job_id;

  IF _team_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.activity_log (team_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata)
    VALUES (
      _team_id,
      NEW.author_id,
      'note_added',
      'candidate_note',
      NEW.id,
      jsonb_build_object('job_id', NEW.job_id, 'resume_id', NEW.resume_id)
    );
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_log_note_added
  AFTER INSERT ON public.candidate_notes
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_note_added();


-- ── 4e. Application received ─────────────────────────────────
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_application_received()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  _team_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Look up team_id from the related job
  SELECT j.team_id INTO _team_id
  FROM public.jobs j
  WHERE j.id = NEW.job_id;

  IF _team_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.activity_log (team_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata)
    VALUES (
      _team_id,
      NULL,  -- applications come from unauthenticated candidates
      'application_received',
      'application',
      NEW.id,
      jsonb_build_object('name', NEW.name, 'job_id', NEW.job_id)
    );
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_log_application_received
  AFTER INSERT ON public.applications
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.log_application_received();


-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 5. COMMENTS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

COMMENT ON TABLE public.activity_log IS 'Team-scoped audit log. Populated by SECURITY DEFINER triggers on team_members, tasks, candidate_notes, and applications.';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.log_member_joined()          IS 'Logs member_joined when a user joins a team.';

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.log_note_added()             IS 'Logs note_added when a candidate note is inserted.';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.log_application_received()   IS 'Logs application_received when a new application is inserted (actor_id is NULL for anon submitters).';

Both features are built, verified, committed, and pushed. Here is a summary of every file created or modified:

**New files**

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/supabase/migrations/20260408100000_add_activity_log.sql`
- `activity_log` table with indexed `(team_id, created_at DESC)` and `(team_id, action)`
- RLS: SELECT for team members via `is_team_member()`, INSERT open for triggers
- Added to `supabase_realtime` publication
- Five SECURITY DEFINER trigger functions: `log_member_joined`, `log_task_created`, `log_task_completed`, `log_note_added`, `log_application_received` — each wrapped in `EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL` to never block the main op

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/hooks/useActivityFeed.tsx`
- `useQuery` with key `["activity-feed", teamId, filter, before]`
- Cursor-based pagination (accumulates pages in local state, resets on filter/teamId change)
- Realtime INSERT subscription per team — prepends new items optimistically and invalidates query cache
- Returns `{ activities, isLoading, isFetching, hasMore, loadMore }`

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/hooks/useTeamDashboard.tsx`
- `useQuery` with `staleTime: 60_000`
- `Promise.all` for: job count, pending task count, member count, last-5 activity items, all assigned tasks
- Second fetch for active candidates (joins resumes via job IDs)
- Returns `TeamDashboardData` including `tasksByAssignee` grouped map

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/ActivityItem.tsx`
- `compact` prop: `true` = dashboard (smaller, timestamp inline), `false` = full page (larger, timestamp below)
- Action icon + human-readable label mapping for all 5 action types
- Actor initials avatar circle (`bg-primary/10 text-primary`)

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/pages/Activity.tsx`
- `SidebarLayout` wrapper with `FadeIn` header and filter tabs (All / Tasks / Notes / Stages / Applications / Members)
- `StaggerList` of `ActivityItem` components
- Loading skeleton, no-team empty state, no-activity empty state, "Load more" button
